descriptor.name: Utah statewide parcels (UGRC) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: Utah Geospatial Resource Center and Utah county recorders/assessors
descriptor.scope: Utah statewide parcel compilation, all 29 counties. PARCEL_ID is county-scoped, so the native key is County plus PARCEL_ID; all source rows sharing that key form one native parcel.
caveats: Some counties publish one parcel as several touching or disjoint rows (observed in Utah County, Provo); all components are fetched and dissolved by polygon union. Rows sharing one key can overlap (Provo samples: 0.003, 0.91, 3.87 and 41.4 m², the last being most of a 71 m² row of Utah~180100174), so disjointParts is not set and the union absorbs the overlap; this is assembly of the publisher rows for one key, not a boundary repair.
Rows with null or blank PARCEL_ID (24,063 statewide on 2026-10-12) are excluded.
Same endpoint as us-ut-salt-lake-city-parcels (County=SaltLake, key PARCEL_ID under US-UT-SALTLAKE-); Salt Lake County parcels would exist under both namespaces.
Layer also publishes address, owner type and account fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: Utah Geospatial Resource Center and Utah counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: UGRC StateWideParcels layer compiles county parcels with a County attribute; all 29 Utah counties present on 2026-10-12.
